other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered female worker or the daughter (legal, adopted or step‑daughter) of a registered construction worker
Applicant must have participated in the "Chief Minister Kanya Vivaah/Nikah Scheme"
Applicant must not have received similar assistance before
Applicant must have engaged in building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months
Registration of the applicant must be renewed annually
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance up to ₹55,000 per marriage, including cash support and material assistance for the bride.
